text: Grothendieck's homotopy hypothesis asserts that $\infty$-groupoids (all morphisms invertible at all levels) are the same as topological spaces up to homotopy equivalence.
explanation: This is precisely the homotopy hypothesis of the chapter: $\{\text{topological spaces}\}/\text{homotopy}\simeq\{\infty\text{-groupoids}\}$, stated there as a theorem in various models. It is what lets homotopy theory be carried out purely algebraically inside $\infty$-categories.
